name: Flare gas recovery
description: Captures gas that would otherwise be flared, using a liquid seal vessel for backpressure control and flashback prevention, plus compression (ejector or compressor) and optional H2S sweetening. Reduces emissions, light, noise and odour and extends flare tip life.

specifications.basis: John Zink states FGR systems are 'custom-engineered' for applications from petroleum refineries to FPSO offshore platforms
John Zink FGR benefit statement; also reduces purchased fuel gas and steam and can lower carbon taxes/fines
Ground flares hide the flame and reduce thermal radiation and noise; open at top with base air openings; multiple tips for turndown; used onshore in sensitive areas and on FPSOs
